name: Hardtack
description: Ship's biscuit. Hard enough to stop a musket ball and about as tasty. Restores 18 HP.

name: Healing Tonic
description: Doc Fennimore's own recipe. Tastes of cloves and regret. Restores 45 HP.

name: Rum Ration
description: The daily tot. Restores 10 HP; in battle it also emboldens (Attack up for 3 turns).

name: Bandage
description: Clean linen. Well, linen. Restores 12 HP and cures a festering bite.
